title: Total CMS Docs
description: Controls who can reach the documentation tools over this site's MCP server.

publicTools.label: Expose documentation tools to anonymous visitors
publicTools.help: Most sites should leave this off — docs_search, docs_get, and docs_lookup are only visible to authenticated MCP callers by default. Turn this on only if your site's anonymous audience is Total CMS builders (e.g. a docs/support site), since it's what makes the tools reachable on a public MCP surface with no login at all.
